parameters.body: Processing your receipt... Please wait a moment.

*AI Bookkeeper - Commands*

Send a photo of your receipt to record an expense.

Available commands:
- *help* - Show this message
- *summary* - This month's spending breakdown
- *summary jan* - Specific month's breakdown
- *budget* - Budget status per category
- *last 5* - Show last 5 transactions (any number)
- *total* - Total spending this month
- *delete last* - Remove the last entry
- *categories* - List all expense categories

Just send a receipt photo to get started!

*Expense Categories:*
